title: Autopilot Protocol V0 — dinh nghia dung chung
description: Kieu nguyen thuy cua giao thuc. Moi schema thong diep va hop dong task deu $ref vao day; doi mot kieu o day la doi cho toan bo giao thuc.

protocolVersion.description: Phien ban giao thuc. Thong diep V1 se khong bao gio validate qua schema V0.

sha40.description: SHA-1 git day du 40 ky tu hex chu thuong. SHA rut gon bi tu choi: 'chinh xac' nghia la khong co hai commit nao cung khop.

issueNumber.description: So GitHub Issue — hop dong task.

prNumber.description: So GitHub Pull Request — ban giao hien thuc.

runId.description: ID mot lan chay GitHub Actions (workflow run id).

risk.description: Lop rui ro. HIGH luon can nguoi duyet truoc khi merge.

runtimeVerdict.description: Ket luan cua Runtime Verifier. FAIL => BLOCKED, khong co duong tu dong nao di tiep.

environment.description: Ten moi truong deploy (vi du gd1-test). Chu thuong, kebab-case, khop voi deployment-targets.

branchName.description: Ten nhanh git: chu, so, dau cham, gach duoi, gach ngang, dau /. Khong bat dau/ket thuc bang ky tu dac biet. Kiem day du theo git check-ref-format la viec cua orchestrator.

taskId.description: Dinh danh task do Architect dat, chu hoa, on dinh trong suot vong doi.

highRiskArea.description: Vung nghiep vu ma giao thuc coi la HIGH toi thieu. Cham vao bat ky vung nao => risk phai la HIGH.
